_comment: COUGAR v1.0 SHORT book — short-laggards leg of the U.S. equity long/short fund. Each tick it ranks the tokenized US-equity universe (config.equities, intersected with the live board + a liquidity floor) by 24h relative strength (own 24h return minus the equity-universe mean), takes the bottom rankPoolSize, and SHORTS those with negative excess + a confirming 4h/1h downtrend (capitulation guard via rsiOversold). Leverage clamped to maxLeverage then each name's HL venue max. Pairs with the LONG book (cougar-long-config.json) on a SEPARATE, equally-funded wallet so the pair is ~market-neutral. Set wallet/strategyId/chatId. Runtime owns position tracking, caps, cooldowns, DSL via runtime-short.yaml. Producer launched with COUGAR_LEG=short.
_persona: U.S. equity dispersion — shorts the weakest tokenized stocks by relative strength, trend-confirmed, market-neutral vs the long book. Capitulation guard avoids shorting an oversold bottom. equities is the trade.xyz US-equity whitelist.
